headline: Nashua School District finances up for discussion and presentation.
summary: Opening items include a prayer by City Clerk Dan Healey and a pledge led by Alderman Patricia Klee. The main business is a discussion or presentation listed under Discussions and/or Presentations.
items: Prayer by City Clerk Dan Healey
Pledge to the flag led by Alderman Patricia Klee
Discussion or presentation on Nashua School District finances
